The manifesto.
Very short.

Your business's first impression lives online. Before they walk through your door, customers have already searched for you, looked at photos, read reviews and decided whether to come in or keep scrolling.

That's why a website isn't a box to tick. It's the first table, the first cut, the first storefront. So it deserves careful typography, photos with room to breathe, a design that doesn't look like a template, and words that sound like you.

That's what we do. Editorial websites, built with craft, for businesses that already have theirs.

Anatomy of a website

The pieces of a complete website.

A professional website isn't just one page: it's several blocks working together. Here's the real case of Santa Malasaña — a barbershop in Madrid — to show you each one with a real screenshot.

— Case study

Santa Malasaña
Barbershop & Grooming

A barbershop with a strong personality that needed to come across the same way online. The site covers every piece it takes to convince a new customer to walk in.

Hero with a brand line, SEO blog with articles on cuts and beard care, editorial gallery, real Google reviews, map, hours and a multi-channel booking menu. Bilingual Spanish/English.

Hero & booking The first thing they see.

A line with personality over a photo of the place. The book and see services buttons visible instantly. Key info — address, hours, phone — at a glance.

Featured services What people ask for most.

Three or four signature services with a short description and a link to the full page. The key: customers see in 10 seconds what you can do for them and whether it fits.

  • 3–4 cards
  • Short description

About the business Who you are.

An honest paragraph about you — no posing, no clichés. What sets you apart from the competition, told your way. It's where customers decide if you're right for them.

What's included
  • Careful copy
  • Photo at work
  • Authentic tone

Editorial gallery Let the work speak.

A mosaic of your best photos. Not a catalog: a showcase. A few well-chosen images, with a click to see more. Filters by type when it makes sense (our work / the space).

  • Photo grid
  • Lazy loading
  • Instagram link
  • Filters

Real reviews Instant trust.

Three verified reviews from Google embedded live on your website. Stars, name, a short quote. If you add the SEO package, we also work on your reviews so they boost your local search rankings.

Short articles about your industry — cuts, care, trends. They bring visits from Google without paying for ads. Up to 12 articles written around the keywords your future customers search for.

Visit us & map How to get there.

Clear address, Embedded Google Maps, full opening hours, tap-to-call phone. Direct WhatsApp, visible email. If a customer wants to come in, don't make them search.

Booking menu You decide how.

When customers tap "book", it works however you like: straight to the channel you prefer (WhatsApp, Booksy, a phone call...) or open a a menu with every option so the customer can choose — like we did for Santa Malasaña.

Technical SEO The invisible part.

Schema.org, sitemap.xml, robots.txt, Open Graph, meta descriptions, image alt text. Google understands your website and ranks you better in local searches. With the SEO package we push your rankings even further. The piece no one sees but that drives everything else.
